items.title: Janmashtami: little Krishnas and Radhas
items.description: Our little ones came dressed as Krishna, Radha and characters from the Janmashtami story. The classroom was transformed into a storytelling set with a flute, dandiya sticks and a lot of smiles.

items.title: Raksha Bandhan with tiny siblings
items.description: A sweet Raksha Bandhan celebration where our toddlers learned about the bond of love between brothers and sisters.

items.title: Independence Day: tricolour all around
items.description: Children dressed as freedom fighters, saluted the flag and took part in Independence Day activities in class.

items.title: Hariyali Teej swings and Mehndi corner
items.description: A flower-decorated swing, a Mehndi Corner and a Choodi Corner made Hariyali Teej a festival of colour at school.

items.title: Summer Camp at Smart Start
items.description: Summer Camp brought outdoor play, creativity and fun to the school grounds under our colourful Summer Camp tent.

items.title: Fashion show on the red carpet
items.description: Our activity hall turned into a ramp with blue and gold balloons as children walked with confidence, guided by their teachers.

items.title: Graduation Day
items.description: Our graduates, dressed in blue gowns, received their scrolls and certificates with their families cheering.

items.title: Annual day on stage
items.description: Costumes, dances and performances: our children took the stage while parents cheered them on.

items.title: Lohri celebration
items.description: A colourful Lohri set with marigold garlands, kites and a bonfire model celebrated the harvest festival with our children.

items.title: Halloween at the school gate
items.description: Our school entrance turned into a spooky-fun Halloween arch for the children.
